name: dextran 70 + hypromellose
uses: Use temporary relief of discomfort due to minor irritations of the eye or to exposure to wind or sun
otcwarn: Do not use if this solution changes color or becomes cloudy if you are sensitive to any ingredient in this product Stop use and ask a doctor if you feel eye pain changes in vision occur redness or irritation of the eye(s) gets worse or lasts more than 72 hours
